business_summary.text: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals operates multi-specialty hospitals in Thane, Pune, Indore and Dombivli, with a pharmacy subsidiary.

call_points.text: Dombivli's first full quarter dragged EBITDA by ₹9.5 Cr, in line with anticipation.
Indore EBITDA margin fell to about 12% on new doctor and team hires ahead of expansion.
All three announced projects are targeted for delivery within five years.
Dombivli is almost entirely self-pay until insurance empanelment completes; management gave no occupancy bump figure.
Doctor hiring at Dombivli will continue for a couple of years, so fixed costs can rise further.
The reported rise in pledged shares was a non-promoter pledge misread after the share split; management says the pledge is unchanged.
Q1 and Q3 are seasonally weaker quarters; Q2 and Q4 are stronger.
Dombivli EBITDA burn is expected to average ₹2 crores to ₹3 crores per month for the year.
Existing hospital occupancies for FY26 stood at 75% for Thane, 65% for Pune, and 45% to 50% for Indore.
Dombivli hospital was operationalized on 25th February 2026, ahead of its scheduled Q1FY27 target date.
Thane, Pune, and Indore hospitals are performing on expected lines.

operating_notes.text: Board approved 1:5 stock split changing face value from Rs. 10 to Rs. 2 per share.
Dombivli hospital operationalized on 25th February 2026 with Phase I capex of approximately ₹425 Cr.
Dombivli hospital operationalized in February 2026 with Phase I capex and 300 beds fitted out.
Dombivli occupancy was 25-30% in its first full quarter, with fixed costs of ₹6-7 Cr a month and 30-40 full-time doctors.
Indore occupancy was about 50% in Q1FY27.
Thane occupancy was ~75% and Pune mid-60%; ARPOB growth of 10% came from case mix and insurance contract renegotiations.

timeline.summary: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹387.84 Cr and PAT of ₹50.27 Cr, and approved a 1:5 stock split and ₹1 interim dividend.
Jupiter Life Line Hospitals reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹371.7 Cr and PAT of ₹50.2 Cr, and highlighted the early operationalization of the Dombivli hospital.
CFO Sivasis Sen resigned effective May 31, 2026.
Jupiter Life Line Hospitals reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,499.8 Cr and PAT of ₹194.2 Cr, and discussed the early operationalization of the Dombivli hospital and expansion plans.

On 3 August 2026 Jupiter Life Line's Q1FY27 call reported total income of ₹411 Cr, EBITDA of ₹79.3 Cr at a 19.3% margin and PAT of ₹37.5 Cr, with Dombivli's first full quarter costing ₹9.5 Cr of EBITDA.
Jupiter Life Line Hospitals executed a ₹500 crore term loan hypothecation agreement with HDFC Bank on October 18, 2026, to fund capital expenditure.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹456.5 Cr (+16.0% YoY), net profit ₹56.36 Cr (-1.9% YoY).
